app_store.promotional_text: Free Google profile audit. AI review replies and weekly posts - nothing publishes without your approval.
app_store.description:
DhandhaAi helps local shops get found on Google Maps and stay active on social media, without a marketing team.

What you get:
- A free audit of your Google Business Profile with a plain-language fix list
- AI-drafted replies to Google reviews in English, Nepali and Hindi
- Festival, offer and product posts with a ready poster image
- Local keyword checks and competitor comparison
- Weekly Google updates, scheduled in one sitting

No sales calls. No autopay lock-in. Transparent pricing printed in the app, and cancel in two clicks.

Built for salons, cafes, clinics, kirana stores and every local business in Nepal and India.
